privacy: Detection is read-only. Credential values are never printed or persisted; only boolean configuration signals are reported.

providers.label: Hermes Agent
providers.setup_hint: Install Hermes if needed, then configure a user-owned model/provider with `hermes setup --portal`.
providers.self_test_hint: Run `hermes status` and an isolated disposable task before making live-execution claims.

providers.label: Codex CLI
providers.setup_hint: Install/authenticate Codex using the user's own OpenAI account or supported credential flow.
providers.self_test_hint: Run an isolated read-only task and capture environment/model/evidence before using it in parity claims.

providers.label: Gemini CLI
providers.setup_hint: Install Gemini CLI and authenticate with the user's own supported OAuth/API-key flow.
providers.self_test_hint: Run the same disposable parity task used by other harnesses before claiming behavioral portability.

providers.label: GitHub Copilot CLI
providers.setup_hint: Install GitHub Copilot CLI and authenticate through the user's own GitHub/Copilot account.
providers.self_test_hint: Run the same disposable parity task used by other harnesses before claiming behavioral portability.

providers.label: Cognee / Hermes memory integration
providers.setup_hint: Install the pinned-compatible Cognee/Hermes integration and configure either local model access or user-owned remote Cognee credentials.
providers.self_test_hint: Execute the repository's eight-case memory-provider contract before changing NOT_RUN/UNPROVEN claims.

providers.label: Browser Use
providers.setup_hint: Install Browser Use and configure a user-owned supported model/provider path.
providers.self_test_hint: Run `npm run browser:self-test:plan` first. When Browser Use and Chrome/Chromium/Edge are present, run `npm run browser:self-test -- --json --out browser-use-self-test.json`. The runner uses a disposable loopback target and isolated temporary browser profile.

providers.label: Playwright MCP
providers.setup_hint: Use a pinned Playwright MCP package version. On-demand npx availability is reported without downloading anything.
providers.self_test_hint: Playwright MCP already has a recorded controlled live candidate result. Use its disposable six-case browser contract as the comparison baseline; the Browser Use self-service runner uses the same six case IDs.
